dataset.name: Notional Maritime Production & Support Challenge — Issue History Register
dataset.fictionalisation_notice: All issues, deviations, root causes, corrective actions, dates, findings, records and lessons are fictional and simplified for hackathon prototyping. They do not represent real defects, safety events, maintenance records, quality findings, customer issues or operational history.
dataset.generated_for: Industrial AI Hackathon — Operational Co-pilot Challenge

issues.title: Obsolete APR-220 installation procedure selected for revision-D rack
issues.description: A technician selected the legacy synthetic revision-B installation procedure while the installed APR-220 configuration record showed revision D.
issues.root_cause: Document search was performed by system type alone and did not filter by configuration effectivity.
issues.impact: Work was paused before physical installation. No synthetic equipment damage or safety consequence occurred.
issues.immediate_action: Block task start, retrieve the revision-D procedure and drawing description, and re-brief the task team.
issues.corrective_action: Add configuration-revision filtering to the work-pack selection workflow and require procedure revision in the installation report.
issues.lesson_learned: System type is insufficient context; the co-pilot must consider model, configuration revision, task type and document applicability.

issues.title: APR-220 post-maintenance test evidence missing at package closure
issues.description: A synthetic maintenance package was presented for closure without an attached accepted post-maintenance test result.
issues.root_cause: The task workflow permitted an operator to mark installation activity complete without checking the linked test requirement.
issues.impact: Return-to-service decision was delayed until test evidence was completed and linked.
issues.immediate_action: Re-open the package, execute the mandatory test workflow and attach the accepted result.
issues.corrective_action: Add a closure gate that blocks completion when mandatory follow-on test evidence is absent.
issues.lesson_learned: The co-pilot should surface task chains and identify uncompleted mandatory work before a report is drafted or closed.

issues.title: Cooling distribution routing clearance below synthetic limit
issues.description: Inspection recorded a synthetic 25 mm cooling-line clearance to the adjacent cable route, below the required synthetic 40 mm threshold.
issues.root_cause: A prior modification did not update line supports after an adjacent cable-route change.
issues.impact: System remains installed but cannot be returned to unrestricted service until rework and functional verification are complete.
issues.immediate_action: Create routing-rework task and hold functional release.
issues.corrective_action: Execute TASK-005, verify clearance, then complete TASK-006 functional verification.
issues.lesson_learned: Inspection findings should automatically generate linked corrective and test tasks when physical constraints are violated.

issues.title: MCS-NX-500 software update attempted before hardware evidence
issues.description: An operator initiated the synthetic SW-4.0 update sequence before the matching revision-C hardware-kit installation record was available.
issues.root_cause: The update request form treated hardware installation and software update as separate activities without enforcing sequencing evidence.
issues.impact: Update was blocked before execution. The planned work window was extended to complete evidence review.
issues.immediate_action: Stop the update and confirm completion of the hardware installation task.
issues.corrective_action: Require the hardware-installation task result and configuration evidence before the software-update action becomes available.
issues.lesson_learned: Co-pilot workflows should make configuration sequence visible and prevent a user from skipping prerequisite evidence.

issues.title: Obsolete SCG-210 checklist used during revision-E verification
issues.description: A revision-C verification checklist was opened for a synthetic SCG-210 gateway with recorded configuration revision E.
issues.root_cause: The checklist repository was indexed by model name but did not surface revision status prominently.
issues.impact: Verification was not accepted; task completion was delayed pending use of the correct revision-E checklist and sign-off.
issues.immediate_action: Discard incomplete legacy checklist, retrieve revision-E checklist and restart verification evidence capture.
issues.corrective_action: Display checklist revision and applicability in selection results; flag obsolete documents before user opening.
issues.lesson_learned: A retrieval interface should prioritise applicable information and make obsolete material visibly unsafe to select.

issues.title: Auxiliary cooling pump functional test blocked by open inspection finding
issues.description: The synthetic functional verification was requested while an inspection finding concerning line-support condition remained open.
issues.root_cause: Inspection status was set to awaiting test without a recorded disposition for the finding.
issues.impact: Functional test remains blocked; the system cannot be presented as verified until the finding is closed or formally accepted.
issues.immediate_action: Request inspection-finding review and record disposition before enabling the functional test.
issues.corrective_action: Add a structured finding-status field to the inspection report and make it a required precondition for test release.
issues.lesson_learned: Status labels alone are insufficient; the co-pilot should identify the specific unresolved condition that blocks the next task.

issues.title: Incomplete module traceability after APR-180 replacement
issues.description: The replacement module identifier was recorded, but the synthetic installation report lacked the applicable drawing and procedure revision references.
issues.root_cause: Report free-text entry did not pre-fill technical context from the selected task and system configuration.
issues.impact: Configuration evidence was incomplete; the record was accepted with limitations pending administrative correction.
issues.immediate_action: Append the applicable procedure and drawing identifiers to the task record and report.
issues.corrective_action: Auto-populate platform, system, configuration revision, task ID and applicable document IDs in the report draft.
issues.lesson_learned: Report drafting is a practical way to improve traceability when the co-pilot carries context forward automatically.
